title: PREI config (schema_version=1)
description: Language-neutral experiment config. One config plus one fixture CSV define one fixed input set. Capital is RMB per installed pile; amortization is years; all cost outputs are RMB per day per whole scenario day.

model_variant.description: legacy_reference reproduces the received formulas and the known full-install EV complaint omission (diagnostic_only). corrected_baseline charges every rejection event exactly once.

source_case.description: Source case label, e.g. final_tvr or final_tvr_v2_fluc_re.

n_spaces.description: Total parking spaces N (spaces, not piles).

installation_cost_rmb_per_pile.description: Installed cost per charging pile, RMB per pile (one-off capital).

amortization_years.description: Straight-line capital amortization period in years.

partial_shared_fraction.description: Fraction h of the N*r charging bays opened to ICEV when r<1. h=0 is a strict partition; h=1 opens every charging bay.

full_install_open_to_all.description: If true, r=1 behaves as an open-to-all lot: only total overflow above N is rejected, split by realised EV/ICEV demand shares.

pile_ratios.description: Candidate pile-to-space ratios r. Continuous ratios; no silent rounding. Must be strictly increasing and include 1.

ev_share_targets.description: Target EV share of arrivals for each simulated day. Must be strictly increasing.

fixture_file.description: CSV path relative to this config file's directory. All pile candidates reuse this one fixture.

units.ev_share_actual: realised EV fraction of arrivals in that hour, dimensionless [0,1]
units.ev_fuel_cost: RMB per rejected EV per day (unit rate, constant within a day)
units.ice_fuel_cost: RMB per rejected ICEV per day (unit rate, constant within a day)
units.ev_time_cost: RMB per rejected EV per day (unit rate, constant within a day)
units.ice_time_cost: RMB per rejected ICEV per day (unit rate, constant within a day)
units.ev_complaint_cost: RMB per rejected EV per day (unit rate, constant within a day)
units.ice_complaint_cost: RMB per rejected ICEV per day (unit rate, constant within a day)

x-fixture_csv.separation: The fixture is sampled once by sample_fixtures.py and never re-drawn during evaluation. Python seeds document Python repetition only; they are not a cross-language common random stream.

daily_optimal.csv.row_semantics: one row per (scenario_id, ev_share_target) day for its optimal candidate; hour=24 denotes the whole-day aggregate

raw_cost_matrix.csv.row_semantics: one row per day x pile ratio; the matrix MATLAB must reproduce for the full cross-language check
raw_cost_matrix.csv.is_optimal: tie set within atol=1e-8 RMB and rtol=1e-10
raw_cost_matrix.csv.g_full_minus_best_partial: C_full - min(C_partial); same value on every row of a day
